close_reason: Verified in code — implementation matches decision exactly.
description: All public MDN structs and enums (Mdn, Disposition, MdnSendRequest, etc.) carry #[non_exhaustive]. This prevents downstream code from constructing them via struct literals, making JSON deserialization the only way to build instances. As a result, any new required field added by a future spec revision causes a compile error in downstream code rather than silently producing a zero-value. In the test backend, this also enforces the JSON-round-trip construction pattern for modified Mdn copies.
title: DECISION: #[non_exhaustive] on all MDN public types
